title: Mintkey AuditEvent
description:
Append-only audit event emitted by every Mintkey container on every state change or auditable action. Discriminated by `event_type`. Common envelope is shared across all event types; per-event payload schemas are pinned per `event_type`.

Stability tier: experimental.

envelope.description: Fields common to every audit event.

request_id.description: Optional ULID identifying the request that produced this event.

trace_id.description: Optional W3C trace-id for cross-service correlation.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous audit event in the tenant's chain (tamper-evidence).

hash.description: Hash of this event over `prev_hash || event_id || event_type || at || payload`.

cascade_count.description: Counts of cascaded resources purged with the tenant. Per ADR-0016.7.

ev_operator_deleted.description: An Operator was soft-deleted (status = disabled). The row is retained for audit history.

openapi_url.description: URL to the service's OpenAPI document, if any.

ev_service_api_keys_cascade_deleted.description: All service_api_keys rows for a service were deleted as part of a transactional cascade delete.

ev_service_permission_grants_cascade_del.description: All permission_grants rows for a service were deleted as part of a transactional cascade delete.

ev_service_credentials_cascade_deleted.description: All credentials rows for a service were deleted as part of a transactional cascade delete.

ev_credential_registered.description: First credential registration on a brand-new service (no prior version).

ev_credential_rotated.description: A new credential `key_version` superseded the previous one.

ev_agent_created.description: Agent was created. Payload carries the API key fingerprint, NOT the plaintext key.

api_key_fingerprint.description: `sha256:<hex>` of the Agent API Key. Plaintext key never appears in audit.

constraints.description: ABAC constraints, closed schema per ADR-0016.4.

rate_limit.description: Per-agent rate limit on this (service, action) tuple.

time_window.description: Time-of-day window the permission is valid in, evaluated in the given IANA timezone.

request_path_prefix.description: Allowed path prefixes within the registered service.

ev_token_issued.description: A brokered JWT was minted by the Credential Broker.

ev_token_denied.description: A `request_token` call was denied by the Credential Broker.

ev_proxy_hit.description: A request flowed through the Egress Proxy. Recorded after the response.

request_path_template.description: Templated path (e.g. `/v1/users/{id}`); raw path is NOT recorded to avoid PII leakage.

auth_method.description: Authentication mechanism used for this proxy request. ADR-0018 §2.4.

api_key_id.description: Present when auth_method=api_key. Never present for brokered_jwt.

key_fingerprint.description: hex(sha256(plaintext)[:8]) — present when auth_method=api_key. Safe in audit.

used_at.description: Coalesced last-used timestamp reported by the proxy (R10.5).

ev_proxy_denied.description: A request was denied at the proxy before forwarding (JWT verify/scope/tnt mismatch/revoked).

jti.description: Optional — may be absent if the token was unparseable.

ev_proxy_error.description: A 5xx outcome at the proxy not attributable to denial — backend error, plugin failure, etc.

scope.description: `instance` = shared-KEK rotation; `tenant` = per-tenant KEK rotation (Phase 2 high-isolation tier).

username_attempted.description: Best-effort attempted identifier; do not log passwords.

ev_audit_chain_verified.title: audit.chain.verified
ev_audit_chain_verified.description: Per-tenant audit hash chain successfully verified end to end. Emitted by the verification job.

first_event_id.description: First event in the verified range.

last_event_id.description: Last event in the verified range.

ev_audit_chain_tampered.title: audit.chain.tampered
ev_audit_chain_tampered.description: Per-tenant audit hash chain found inconsistent. Emitted by the verification job. Triggers operator alarm.

ev_settings_updated.title: settings.updated
ev_settings_updated.description: Admin-level settings changed (internal_auth, oidc, audit retention, etc.). Per ADR-0016.6.

ev_platform_admin_access.title: platform_admin.access
ev_platform_admin_access.description: PlatformAdmin cross-tenant read access (audit query, changes feed, list endpoints). Per ADR-0017.4.

viewed_tenant_ids.description: Empty array or ["__all__"] when reading across all tenants.

endpoint.description: Canonical OpenAPI operationId of the read.

ev_service_test_executed.title: service.test_executed
ev_service_test_executed.description: Operator clicked the Test button on a service; the broker invoked the registered backend with the current credential. Per F-OP-03.

status_code.description: 0 if no HTTP response was received.

ok.description: True iff status_code is 2xx and no transport error.

error.description: Transport error category if not ok (e.g., timeout, dns_failure, tls_failure).

ev_api_key_created.title: api_key.created
ev_api_key_created.description: A service API key was created. Payload carries the fingerprint, NOT the plaintext. Req 11.3; ADR-0018 §4.

ev_api_key_revoked.title: api_key.revoked
ev_api_key_revoked.description: A service API key was revoked by an operator. Triggers proxy cache eviction via pg_notify. Req 11.3; ADR-0018 §4.1.

ev_api_key_rotated.title: api_key.rotated
ev_api_key_rotated.description: A service API key was rotated (new key created with same binding; old key NOT revoked). Req 11.3; ADR-0018 §5.

ev_tenant_bootstrap_completed.title: tenant.bootstrap_completed
ev_tenant_bootstrap_completed.description: First-time bootstrap of a tenant completed by the seed job. Per F-OP-01.

ev_ssh_session_started.title: ssh.session.started
ev_ssh_session_started.description: An SSH session was established via the SSH proxy bastion. Per ADR-0021.

ev_ssh_session_exec.title: ssh.session.exec
ev_ssh_session_exec.description: A command was executed in an SSH session. Per ADR-0021.

command.description: The command executed (may be truncated for very long commands).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the command (0 = success).

ev_ssh_session_sftp.title: ssh.session.sftp
ev_ssh_session_sftp.description: An SFTP operation was performed in an SSH session. Per ADR-0021.

path.description: The file/directory path affected by the operation.

ev_ssh_session_ended.title: ssh.session.ended
ev_ssh_session_ended.description: An SSH session was terminated. Per ADR-0021.

bytes_sent.description: Total bytes sent from agent to backend.

bytes_received.description: Total bytes received from backend to agent.

ev_email_service_registered.title: email.service.registered
ev_email_service_registered.description: An email service was registered. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_service_updated.title: email.service.updated
ev_email_service_updated.description: An email service's metadata was updated. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_service_deleted.title: email.service.deleted
ev_email_service_deleted.description: An email service was deleted. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_oauth2_authorize_initiated.title: email.oauth2.authorize_initiated
ev_email_oauth2_authorize_initiated.description: OAuth2 authorization code flow initiated; state token inserted into oauth2_state with 10-min TTL. Payload contains only state_token_hash (sha256 of raw state) — never the raw state value (NFR-17). Per ADR-0024.

state_token_hash.description: sha256(raw_state_value) hex digest. Raw state value is NEVER stored in audit (NFR-17).

ev_email_oauth2_authorized.title: email.oauth2.authorized
ev_email_oauth2_authorized.description: OAuth2 consent flow completed; refresh token stored in vault. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_oauth2_refreshed.title: email.oauth2.refreshed
ev_email_oauth2_refreshed.description: OAuth2 access token refreshed successfully via admin-api proxy. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_oauth2_expired.title: email.oauth2.expired
ev_email_oauth2_expired.description: OAuth2 refresh token expired or was revoked; re-authorization required. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_mailboxes_listed.title: email.mailboxes.listed
ev_email_mailboxes_listed.description: Agent listed mailboxes for an email service. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_messages_listed.title: email.messages.listed
ev_email_messages_listed.description: Agent listed email messages in a mailbox. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_message_read.title: email.message.read
ev_email_message_read.description: Agent fetched the full content of an email message. Per ADR-0024.

message_id.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID or UID (not body content).

ev_email_message_flags_updated.title: email.message.flags_updated
ev_email_message_flags_updated.description: Agent updated IMAP flags on an email message. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_message_deleted.title: email.message.deleted
ev_email_message_deleted.description: Agent deleted (expunged) an email message. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_message_moved.title: email.message.moved
ev_email_message_moved.description: Agent moved an email message to a different mailbox. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_message_sent.title: email.message.sent
ev_email_message_sent.description: Agent sent an email message via SMTP. Per ADR-0024. Subject truncated to 100 chars; recipient count only (no addresses) in audit for PII safety.

recipient_count.description: Total recipient count (to+cc+bcc). Addresses not logged.

subject_truncated.description: Subject truncated to 100 chars for audit.

ev_email_credential_set.title: email.credential.set
ev_email_credential_set.description: A username+password credential was stored for an email_password or email_app_password email service. Payload NEVER contains the username or password (NFR-17). Per ADR-0024.

service_id.description: Email service UUID (string form). NOT a svc_ prefixed ULID — email services use UUID4.

auth_scheme.description: The auth scheme of the email service. email_oauth2 is never set via this path.

ev_email_credential_deleted.title: email.credential.deleted
ev_email_credential_deleted.description: The stored credential for an email service was revoked/deleted. Per ADR-0024.

ev_email_permission_grant_created.title: email_permission_grant.created
ev_email_permission_grant_created.description: An agent was granted access to an email service. Per feat/email-permission-grants.

ev_email_permission_grant_revoked.title: email_permission_grant.revoked
ev_email_permission_grant_revoked.description: An agent's access to an email service was revoked. Per feat/email-permission-grants.

ev_agent_secret_created.title: agent_secret.created
ev_agent_secret_created.description: An agent stored a new named secret. Payload is identifier-only — no secret value. Per ADR-0025.

ev_agent_secret_updated.title: agent_secret.updated
ev_agent_secret_updated.description: An agent overwrote an existing named secret (version incremented). Payload is identifier-only — no secret value. Per ADR-0025.

ev_agent_secret_read.title: agent_secret.read
ev_agent_secret_read.description: An agent read the plaintext value of a secret. Every successful plaintext read is audited. Payload is identifier-only — never contains the value. Per ADR-0025.

reader_agent_id.description: Agent that performed the read (owner or grant holder).

access.description: Whether the reader is the owner or a share-grant recipient.

ev_agent_secret_deleted.title: agent_secret.deleted
ev_agent_secret_deleted.description: An agent secret was deleted (cascades share grants). Per ADR-0025.

name.description: Secret name at time of deletion.

grants_cascade_count.description: Number of share grants deleted by cascade.

ev_agent_secret_grant_created.title: agent_secret_grant.created
ev_agent_secret_grant_created.description: An operator granted a recipient agent read-only access to an agent secret. Per ADR-0025.

ev_agent_secret_grant_revoked.title: agent_secret_grant.revoked
ev_agent_secret_grant_revoked.description: An operator revoked a recipient agent's read access to an agent secret. Per ADR-0025.

ev_budget_threshold_reached.title: budget.threshold_reached
ev_budget_threshold_reached.description: Budget consumption crossed a configured alert threshold. Emitted by the proxy plugin. Per FR-7, design §7.

ev_budget_exceeded.title: budget.exceeded
ev_budget_exceeded.description: A request was denied because the budget ceiling was reached. Emitted by the proxy plugin. Per FR-7, design §7.

denied_jti.description: JTI of the denied request token.

ev_budget_config_updated.title: budget.config_updated
ev_budget_config_updated.description: An operator updated budget configuration on a permission grant. Per FR-7, design §7.

ev_budget_reset.title: budget.reset
ev_budget_reset.description: An operator manually reset the budget for a permission grant mid-period. Per FR-7, design §7.
